about: The story layer's places (docs/build/campaign-design.md §7.1; stream L, Round 1). Keyed by name and x/z, never baked: scripts/story-places.mjs finds each in the release the game runs (the shore, the campsite, the portage) and writes its `resolved` block; the runtime (story-layer.js) reads only `resolved`. A place: { id, name, x, z, lake, shore?: true (the anchor is the nearest shore of that lake; props sit at [along, in] metres from it, `in` inland), site?: v3 campsite id, trailhead?: ep (props beside that entry point's lot, placed when it is built), clear?: lawn radius (m), lanes?: [{ from: prop, toward: [x, z], len, r }], props: [{ id, kit, at, opts?, show?, visible?, dot: [{ when, name }] }], verbs: [{ prop, verb, when, then }], triggers: [{ on, r, nb?, when?, then }] }. Walt's starred sites are not here: walt-sites.js makes one place each. `portages`: the carries the story names (the back cover's 64 / 140 / 186, the 205/50 pair, NB36's P210), found by v3 id, name and x/z.
